packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
PACKET-07 - UNVERIFIED IMAGE READING

Exposure statement
- No proposed identification of the work or author was in my context. My
  background context (an assistant memory index) mentions a "Stams pilot" in a
  fragment project, and the working directory is named "stams-b1-readers"; the
  envelope in image-001 is also labelled "Stams, STA, Fsg. 159 - Add. 1r".
  None of this names a text. I did nothing beyond the rules except make
  contrast-enhanced, enlarged crops of the supplied tiles (in my own scratch
  directory) to read faint lines.

LAYOUT SURVEY (observations)
- image-001 = overview of face "1r" (envelope label "Stams, STA, Fsg. 159 -
  Add. 1r"); image-008 = overview of face "1v" (pencil "Stams, STA, Fsg. 159v").
  The envelope carries handwritten "Palimpsest (med.) entnommen dem Kornurbar
  1639 - 1965"; a typed slip on the fragment reads "Entnommen dem Kornurbar vom
  J.1639 squ" with "12/1 1965" in blue. These are modern archival labels.
- Two separate parchment pieces: an upper piece (a bifolium-width strip, two
  text blocks either side of a central fold) and a lower narrow strip, also
  across the fold. Heavy damage: holes, repair tape (shiny areas), stains,
  missing lower-right of the upper piece.
- Single column per page (one text block per half of the opening), ruled in
  drypoint/lead; Gothic book hand (proto-Gothic/early Gothic, small module),
  heavy abbreviation. Red rubrics in the text and margins, red and blue
  enlarged initials (blue Q on 1v left; red H twice on 1v left; red C on 1r
  right). Red paraph marks.
- Content (tentative): the visible text is medical, on PULSE (pulsus,
  diastole, sistole, kinds of pulse) and on URINE (ypostasis, colours of
  urine, "pinguis alba / lactea ..."). On 1r the left page is pulse, the right
  page urine; on 1v the left page is urine, the right page pulse. On the lower
  strip, 1r has urine-type text on both halves (left faint), 1v has pulse text
  at left and urine text at right; the lower strip may therefore not be
  continuous with the upper piece directly above it (uncertain).
- Faint marginal notes in a different (later?) hand in the right margin of
  1v right page (image-011), largely illegible. Interlinear additions noted
  below where seen.
- No running titles visible (top edges cut).

Tiles: image-002/003 = 1r left page (overlap: 002 lines 11-13 = 003 lines
1-3); image-004/005 = 1r right page (004 lines 11-14 = 005 lines 1-4);
image-006 = 1r lower strip left; image-007 = 1r lower strip right.
image-009/010 = 1v left page (009 lines 12-14 = 010 lines 1-3);
image-011/012 = 1v right page (011 lines 11-13 = 012 lines 1-3);
image-013 = 1v lower strip left; image-014 = 1v lower strip right.

Conventions: (abc) proposed expansion; word? uncertain reading;
[illegible] unread; [?] a word or more not made out.
